details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:244-290 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Read-role Claude children are launched without stripping runner credentials or isolating `GH_CONFIG_DIR`.
  WHY: They can inherit write-capable credentials and saved GitHub authentication, allowing prompt-injected models to perform authenticated GitHub writes.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:165 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `READ_PROFILE_ALLOW` still permits `Bash(gh api *)`.
  WHY: Read-role models can invoke GitHub API commands through the allow list and bypass the guard hook.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:161 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `READ_PROFILE_ALLOW` still permits `Bash(git grep*)`.
  WHY: `git grep` can invoke external pager or diff commands in some configurations, allowing arbitrary command execution without a permission prompt.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:lines 476-488 (render_settings) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `render_settings` does not append `--read-only` to the guard hook command for read profiles.
  WHY: Read-role children run the guard in its default interactive mode rather than the intended deny mode.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1427-1551 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The guard does not implement the read-only mode interface: `evaluate()` lacks a `read_only` parameter and `main()` does not parse `--read-only`.
  WHY: The read-only checks cannot be activated by the hook command, leaving read-role calls in the default interactive mode.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1427 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The template guard copy's `evaluate()` signature lacks a `read_only` parameter.
  WHY: Consumer repositories synced from the template would lack the read-only guard mode.
- tests/test_claude_settings_policy.py:85 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `test_guard_hook_runs_on_every_bash_call` does not account for the `--read-only` suffix.
  WHY: The assertion would fail if read-only hook wiring were added.
- tests/test_claude_settings_policy.py:133 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `test_settings_cli_writes_owner_only_file` does not account for the `--read-only` suffix.
  WHY: The assertion would fail if read-only hook wiring were added.
- tests/test_ai_engine.py:lines 300-349 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: No test verifies that read-profile Claude children run without GitHub, Telegram, OpenRouter, or Actions OIDC credentials.
  WHY: Credential-stripping regressions would be undetectable.
- tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:lines 975-1019 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: No read-only mode tests cover write denial, approved reads, uncertain calls, CLI arguments, or invalid payloads.
  WHY: Regressions in read-only guard behavior would be undetectable.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:lines 1447-1473 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The read-only echo-substitution path does not enforce the `github.com` hostname restriction.
  WHY: Echo-wrapped `gh api --hostname` calls to arbitrary hosts can be classified as GET reads and approved.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:evaluate() lines 1502-1510 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The read-only hostname check validates only the `--hostname` flag, not absolute URL endpoints.
  WHY: Absolute URLs to arbitrary hosts leave `parsed["hostname"]` unset and can pass the check as GET reads.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:evaluate() lines 1465-1473 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: In compound commands containing an echo substitution, outer `gh api` calls are evaluated with standard `classify()` rather than read-only restrictions.
  WHY: Outer HEAD, GraphQL, or external-host calls may be approved without the read-only checks.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:echo path lines 1465-1469 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The echo-substitution path does not re-check the GraphQL restriction enforced by the main read-only classification loop.
  WHY: The echo path checks only that the description starts with `GET `, potentially allowing a non-REST call.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:evaluate() echo path lines 1465-1472 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The template guard's echo-substitution path does not enforce the `github.com` hostname restriction.
  WHY: Consumer repositories can allow echo-wrapped GET requests to arbitrary hosts.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:evaluate() main loop hostname check ~line 1503 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The template guard's hostname restriction checks only the `--hostname` flag, not absolute URL endpoints.
  WHY: Absolute URLs to arbitrary hosts can pass the check with no hostname flag set.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:lines 150-151 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The comment says the guard denies every write even though the hook does not deny writes in its current form and `READ_PROFILE_ALLOW` still includes `Bash(gh api *)`.
  WHY: The misleading comment could lead developers and operators to believe read profiles are write-protected.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Give read-role model processes a read-only GitHub identity."
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_engine.sh or the security-audit workflow's credential setup
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/ai_engine.sh:261-289 / scripts/ai_engine.sh:244-290 lack the described credential isolation or separate read-only identity; README.md (lines 1992-1995), README.md:1987-2001, and changelog.d/6216-claude-read-role-api-writes.md are cited as documenting that private-repository reads remain unavailable or as absent from the working tree.
- requirement: "Deny all API writes in the read-role hook policy while leaving write-role and interactive behavior unchanged."
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py evaluate
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `render_settings` at line 476 is reported to lack `--read-only` wiring; `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1427-1611` is reported to lack the read-only helper, parameter, CLI parsing, and classification checks; z-ai_glm-5_2 reports hostname and absolute-URL bypasses in the wrapper.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  WHY: Read-profile Claude children inherit the runner's GitHub, Telegram, OpenRouter, and Actions OIDC credentials, enabling authenticated GitHub writes.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:line 165 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `"Bash(gh api *)"` remains in `READ_PROFILE_ALLOW`.
  WHY: Read-profile models can invoke `gh api` in dontAsk mode, bypassing the hook-based guard.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:line 161 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `"Bash(git grep*)"` remains in `READ_PROFILE_ALLOW`.
  WHY: `git grep` can invoke external pager or diff commands in certain configurations, allowing arbitrary commands without a permission prompt.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:lines 476-488 (render_settings) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `render_settings` does not append `--read-only` to the gh api guard hook command for read profiles.
  WHY: Read-profile Claude children run the guard in default interactive mode rather than deny mode.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:line 1427 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `def evaluate(payload: dict)` does not accept a `read_only` parameter.
  WHY: The guard has no mechanism to act on the `--read-only` flag.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:line 1551 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `def main()` does not accept `argv` or parse `--read-only`.
  WHY: The appended command-line argument is not handled by the hook.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:line 1427 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The template copy has the same old `def evaluate(payload: dict)` signature without a `read_only` parameter.
  WHY: Consumer repositories synced from this template carry a guard hook that lacks read-only mode.
- tests/test_claude_settings_policy.py:line 85 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `test_guard_hook_runs_on_every_bash_call` asserts `'python3 "/support/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py"'` without `--read-only`.
  WHY: If the wiring were added, this assertion would not match the rendered command.
- tests/test_claude_settings_policy.py:line 133 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `test_settings_cli_writes_owner_only_file` asserts that `"command"` ends with `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py"` without checking ` --read-only`.
  WHY: The assertion does not account for the read profile's `--read-only` suffix.
- tests/test_ai_engine.py:lines 300-349 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `test_read_profile_strips_credentials_from_claude_only` does not exist.
  WHY: Credential-stripping regressions in `ai_engine.sh` would be undetectable.
- tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:lines 975-1019 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The listed read-only mode tests are absent.
  WHY: Regressions in read-only guard logic would be undetectable by the test suite.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:lines 1447-1459 (echo-substitution path in evaluate) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The echo-substitution fast path does not check parsed hostname.
  WHY: A read-only mode could approve GET requests to arbitrary hosts through echo substitution.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:lines 261-289 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `claude_run` executes Claude without credential isolation.
  WHY: Read-role Claude children inherit runner credentials and any GitHub login on disk.

  WHY: Developers and operators may believe read profiles are write-protected when they are not.
